name: updates-page
description: Publish, update, schedule and list changelog entries on updates.page from your terminal or an agent session.

interface.shortDescription: Publish your changelog from the terminal or an agent session.
interface.longDescription: Turn what you just shipped into a customer-facing changelog entry on updates.page. Reads your commits or a diff, writes the entry for a reader rather than a contributor, and leaves it as a draft for you to approve before it reaches your public page, your RSS feed and your embedded widget.
defaultPrompt: Draft a changelog entry for what I just shipped.
Turn the commits since my last tag into release notes.
Announce this release on our changelog.
